fields.title: 📖 Tie her and trust
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Tie her and trust in Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **Tawakkul** does not mean abandoning the means. The believer takes the permitted means and still binds his heart ***to Allah alone***.

immutable.source: 📝 at-Tirmidhī, al-Jāmiʿ, Kitāb Ṣifat al-Qiyāmah wa’r-Raqāʾiq wa’l-Waraʿ, Hadith Nr. 2517; überliefert von Anas ibn Mālik.
